purpose: establish a conservative non-LLM baseline before provider comparison

expectations.note: The target explicitly describes failure of the prior retry and changes the repair mechanism; the boundary between response and refinement is semantically close.
The target explicitly says the #6 masking path still left glossary leak-through and separates the mechanisms.
A related-context reference alone must not create a direct semantic edge.

limitations: Keyword rules cannot reliably distinguish responds_to from refines when a refinement is motivated by a failure.
Rules do not understand paraphrase beyond the small explicit pattern set.
This baseline is a lower bound for later semantic providers, not a production reasoner.
